Bridge remains pumped while SERVICE_START/RESOLVING/HTTP/SERVICE_STOP. Daemon earlyexit is stickyfailure. After actual HTTP EOF/shutdown/drain, parent requests daemonTERM, drains stdio, waits actual exitEINTR4 with TERMsent/noKILL and bothEOF, then retires exact owned endpoint identities.

Only after daemoncleanup and quiescent queues does parent emit codecCLOSE; bothCLOSE/parserquiescence precede final route/interface close. Cleanup failure paths still stop/drain/reap sole-owned children under5s then closeTCP/ownedinterface, with sticky failures and no cachedPID signaling after reap/lost ownership.
